messages.content: Predict the actual human choice in this one-shot, anonymous four-player public-goods game. Both available group types are described as trying to maximize group profit through high individual contributions. A group with a commitment signal requires an entry fee that is burned: it is not a gift to group members or an investment in the common pool. A group without a signal has no entry fee. Participants are matched with three other people of the same group type and cost condition after choices have been collected. Each player independently contributes any integer number of US cents from zero up to their remaining game budget, without observing the other players’ current contributions, and keeps the uninvested game money. The common pool is doubled and shared equally among the four members, regardless of individual contribution. You receive a USD1 show-up fee plus game earnings. The initial game endowment is USD2. A signaling fee is deducted from that endowment before contribution; people without a signal retain the full USD2 game budget. You are choosing between entering with a signal and entering without a signal. Return only join_with_signal or join_without_signal.

The signaling fee in your current cost condition is 30 US cents. Join with a signal: game contribution budget 170cents; join without a signal: game contribution budget200cents. Both options are currently available. Before this cost condition/group decision, you completed an initial public-goods task with a100cent endowment. Your recorded earlier base contribution was 56cents. Your earlier conditional contribution plan for hypothetical average contributions of the other players of0,5,10,...,100cents, respectively, was [0,0,1,1,1,1,1,7,31,39,52,52,52,53,53,53,53,53,53,53,53]cents. These are earlier stated contingent choices, not observed current partner contributions or21 realized rounds. The available record does not supply the earlier task’s specific payoff or feedback; do not infer the person did not experience it. Participant background: recruited from the general US population on Prolific; age 37years.
